scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 23 boards of two live Deity Religious-target games of 2026-11-18, each the run's events.jsonl cut right after the turn's first state frame: Mali civvis-20261118T082214Z at t104, t119 and every third turn to t158, and t162 (Portugal met at t119, its first city seen at t159), and Khmer civvis-20261118T102229Z at t112, t136, t144, t152, t160, t168 and t176 (one of Ethiopia's fifteen cities on the map from t134 to t160). Both arms run one civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch (00d642d5e7) with the run's own requested genome, religion-seat-charts-the-rivals and last-charge-joins-the-army included; the on arm adds --with religion-seat-seeks-the-unseen-rival. Orders differ on 15 of 23 boards and the gene's journal line is on 20; the two boards before any overseas rival was met (Mali t104, Khmer t112) are identical. 28 religious units carry a different order, 4 of them a move in place of a spread. On the Mali boards from t131 to t155 the changed unit's ordered tile is nearer the closest Portuguese city (as known at the end of the game) than the off arm's on 7 orders, farther on 3 and level on 2. A one-frame query has no memory, so the seekers are chosen afresh on every board and no goal is kept between turns.
